chunks.text: Today we will learn about a very small country in Europe.
The country is Andorra.
I will speak slowly and use easy English.
Fact one.
Andorra is in Europe.
Andorra is a small country in southwestern Europe.
It is between Spain and France.
The country is in the Pyrenees Mountains.
Even though it is very small, it is famous around the world.
Many visitors come every year.
Fact two.
The capital city is Andorra -Laveya.
Andorra -Laveya is the capital city.
It is also the largest city in the country.
The city is surrounded by mountains.
People enjoy shopping, walking and relaxing there.
It is one of the highest capital cities in Europe.
Fact three.
Andorra is one of the smallest countries in the world.
Only about 90,000 people live in Andorra.
The country is much smaller than most European countries.
Because it is small, many places are close together.
Traveling around the country is easy.
Visitors can see many places in one day.
Fact four.
Andorra is famous for its mountains.
The Pyrenees Mountains cover most of the country.
The mountains are green in summer.
In winter, they are covered with snow.
The views are beautiful in every season.
Nature is one of Andorra's greatest treasures.
Fact five.
There are no airports in Andorra.
Andorra does not have an airport.
People usually travel there by car or bus.
The nearest airports are in Spain and France.
Many visitors enjoy the scenic mountain roads.
The journey is part of the adventure.
Fact six.
Skiing is very popular.
Every winter, thousands of people visit Andorra.
They come to ski and snowboard.
The country has many modern ski resorts.
People of all ages enjoy winter sports.
Snow brings many tourists every year.
Fact seven.
Summer is also beautiful.
In summer, the mountains become green.
People enjoy hiking and cycling.
Fresh air and beautiful views attract many visitors.
The weather is warm but comfortable.
Nature lovers enjoy every season.
Fact eight.
The official language is Catalan.
People in Andorra speak Catalan.
Many people also speak Spanish, French, and English.
Visitors can communicate easily.
Learning a few Catalan words is fun.
Language is an important part of the country's identity.
Fact nine.
Shopping is very popular.
Many visitors come to buy clothes, perfumes, and electronics.
There are many shops in the capital.
Some products are less expensive than in nearby countries.
Shopping is an important part of tourism.
The streets are busy with visitors.
Fact ten.
Andorra has a high quality of life.
The country is clean and safe.
People enjoy peaceful towns and beautiful nature.
Health care and education are good.
Many families enjoy living there.
Life is calm and comfortable.
Fact eleven.
There are many rivers.
Small rivers flow through the mountains.
The water is clean and fresh.
Bridges connect different towns.
The rivers make the landscape even more beautiful.
People enjoy walking near the water.
Fact twelve.
Andorra has beautiful old villages.
Many villages have stone houses.
The streets are quiet and clean.
Old churches can be found in many places.
Visitors enjoy exploring these charming villages.
They show the country's long history.
Fact thirteen.
Family is very important.
Families spend time together.
People enjoy eating together on weekends.
Children often play outside.
Neighbors additional food is delicious.
People enjoy meat, potatoes, cheese and vegetables.
Warm soups are popular during winter.
Fresh bread is served with many meals.
Mountain food is simple but tasty.
Visitors enjoy trying local dishes.
Fact fifteen.
Football and cycling are popular sports.
Many children play football.
People also enjoy cycling in the mountains.
Professional cyclists often train in Andorra.
The mountain roads are perfect for cycling.
Sports are an important part of daily life.
Fact sixteen.
Wildlife lives in the mountains.
People may see deer, wild boars, foxes and many birds.
The forests are full of life.
Nature is protected in many areas.
Visitors enjoy watching animals from a safe distance.
The countryside is peaceful.
Fact seventeen.
Tourism is very important.
Millions of people visit every year.
Some come for skiing.
Others come for hiking, shopping or relaxing.
Tourism helps the country's economy.
Visitors often return again.
Fact eighteen.
Andorra has many sunny days.
The country enjoys plenty of sunshine.
Even in winter the sky is often blue.
The fresh mountain air feels clean.
Sunny weather makes outdoor activities enjoyable.
People spend a lot of time outside.
Fact nineteen.
Andorra is a peaceful country.
The country has a calm lifestyle.
People enjoy nature in quiet towns.
Visitors often say they feel relaxed.
The beautiful mountains create a peaceful atmosphere.
Many people visit to escape busy city life.
Fact twenty.
Andorra is a wonderful country to discover.
It has high mountains, beautiful villages, clean rivers and friendly people.
Visitors can enjoy skiing in winter and hiking in summer.
The country may be small but it offers many unforgettable experiences.
Andorra is one of Europe's hidden gems.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English podcast.
I hope you learned something new today.
Keep listening, keep practicing and keep enjoying English.
